restriction_review.scope: 28 independent missing affinity tonic manufacturing bodies, selected tiers I-V. Every selected output primary EQ item ID, literal formula, individual numeric trivial, Shaman requirement and explicit charge1/stack20 profile directly observed. Explicit source learned-as labels distinguish tierV Powder of Ro and Versluierd Fungus bodies; both are literal separately listed source formulas, not invented substitutions. Same-output variants stay together in one packet. Already represented BenefitII is outside the absent queue and is not inserted.

Labelled PoR11 family reconstruction only, with maintained-primary literal manufacturing authority. Individual full bodies, numeric trivials and V variant availability are not asserted immutable2006/May2013 fields or exact introduction dates. No VI+ inference.

Omitted minimum skill0, ordinary must_learn0/book0/quest0/enabled1/nofail0 policy. Source Learned as labels name the manufacturing bodies; they do not assert a mandatory book. No core edits or native acceptance.
restriction_review.quantity: Each primary output explicitly Charges1/stack20/yield1 matches current native maxcharges1/stackable1/stacksize20. successcount1 is one physical one-charge potion, no maximum default. Distinct per-body ingredient multiplicities and numeric trivials preserved, including Powder of Ro2 versus Versluierd Fungus1. No co-products or failure returns stated or invented.
restriction_review.containers: Each body binds one explicitly permitted authenticated portable bag. Medicine Bag17901 primary1141 uses current eight slots/LARGE; nine Fungus bodies that omit ordinary Medicine Bag bind Reinforced Medicine Bag17811 primary1824, current ten slots/GIANT. Source explicitly notes former name Bearskin Potion Bag. All full ingredient quantities and native sizes fit selected bag. ChromaticV explicitly lists ordinary Medicine Bag and fits it. Capacity alone does not expand source-listed permissions. Other bags/modern tables held separately.
restriction_review.preservation: 71 exact18-field dependencies: 46 fresh/25 reused. Zero current all-state/all-skill full-input/name matches or output peers. New IDs, full logical entry multisets, item field preimages, count deltas and learned refs guarded. Existing recipes/items/quests/player data unchanged.
